title: Alert levels: the target state the beast's scripts read

states.label: Normal
states.summary: Nothing on its target list. The level is worked out again every think, so it falls back here once the list holds nothing that gives a higher level (when entries are dropped is not traced yet).
states.source: ai_perception_update 0x016a85c0; level numbers checked by the verified IsBattleState / IsCautionState / IsFindState bindings

states.label: Caution
states.summary: Level 1. The scripts ask for it with IsCautionState.

states.label: Find
states.summary: Level 2. The scripts ask for it with IsFindState.

states.label: Battle
states.summary: Level 3. The scripts ask for it with IsBattleState. For the clinic beast this is the level our reading says makes it get up.

transitions.label: noticed
transitions.condition: Something noticed gets a new entry on the target list. Static reading of the routine that fills in a new entry (not replaced yet): it starts at caution or find depending on which sense noticed it.

transitions.label: noticed
transitions.condition: As above: which sense gives which starting level is not traced yet.

transitions.label: raised?
transitions.condition: How an entry's level rises is in the target-list ageing routine, which has not been read yet.

transitions.label: forced
transitions.condition: A 'force battle' request left in the perception's flags puts the main target's entry straight into battle, once. Replaced in Paleblood and tested on edge cases; who sends the request is not known.
